lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-layered horizontal sequence along the mid-lateral flank, with higher density observed posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature with a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of associated fish (remoras) located beneath the pectoral fin and along the ventral midline.
